answer: Approval requires signers drawn from at least three separate invitation subtrees with no shared inviter within five hops, so one farm branch can occupy only one slot in any approving panel no matter how many identities it registers. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Picture an inlet with one ticket, a violet that separates tickets from strangers, and a bridge that tallies tickets by tree: buying more identities in one inlet changes nothing about the violet or the bridge tally.
